text: ♫ (Intro Instrumental) ♫
[Verse 1] Kaisi yeh dhun hai, dil mein samaayi
Har pal, har lamha, teri hi parchhaayi
Kalyani naam tera, rooh mein basa hai
Har saans meri, tujhko hi dhoonde
Teri aankhon mein hai, ek gehra samandar
Jismein kho jaaun main, baahon mein teri
[Chorus] O Kalyani, tu meri zindagaani
Tu hi meri subha, tu hi meri shaam
Har pal, har dum, hai bas tera hi naam
Teri muskaan, jaise chandni raat
Chamke sitaron si, teri har baat
[Verse 2] Jab se mile ho, badla hai jahaan
Har khwaab, har aarzoo, tujhmein hi rawaan
Dil ke har kone mein, tera hi basera
Kalyani, tu hi toh hai, mera savera
Kya jaadu kiya hai, tune mujhpe sanam
Tere bina ab, ek pal bhi na hum
[Chorus] O Kalyani, tu meri zindagaani
Tu hi meri subha, tu hi meri shaam
Har pal, har dum, hai bas tera hi naam
Teri muskaan, jaise chandni raat
Chamke sitaron si, teri har baat
[Bridge] Sargam mein tu, raagon mein tu
Har taal, har sur, tera hi roop
Meri har dhun mein, tera hi sangeet
Yeh pyaar ka bandhan, hai amar preet
Haa, Kalyani, Kalyani
♫ (Instrumental Break) ♫
[Chorus] O Kalyani, tu meri zindagaani
Tu hi meri subha, tu hi meri shaam
Har pal, har dum, hai bas tera hi naam
Teri muskaan, jaise chandni raat
Chamke sitaron si, teri har baat
[Outro] Teri adaaon pe, main fida hoon
Tere ishq mein, main bekhabar hoon
Yeh zindagi ab, tere hawale
Tu hi meri manzil, tu hi kinaara
Kalyani, Kalyani...
♫ (Instrumental Break) ♫
O Kalyani, meri Kalyani
Tere bin ab na jee sakoon main
Har pal mein, har saans mein tu
Kalyani, mere dil ki rani
♫ (Music Fades) ♫
Kalyani...
♫ (Song Ends) ♫
